FAQ
Application Procedure and Deadlines for all Graduate Programs
Graduate study may begin any semester.
We accept online applications (if the online application system asks for your passport number, and you do not have a passport, put "0000" as the passport number). Applications are evaluated only when all the following items have been received:
Statement of purpose.
Original academic transcripts (by mail, posted to the Director of Graduate Studies)
Applicants must have GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
GRE general test scores - Institution code 5815, Department code 0402.
Applicants must rank in the 65% percentile or higher in the Quantitative Reasoning test. There is no minimal score requirement for the other parts of the GRE.
Students from non-English speaking countries must send either TOEFL or IELTS scores.
TOEFL: Institution code 5815, Department code 078.
Minimum score requirement: Internet based - 92; Computer based - 237; Paper based - 580.
IELTS: Minimum score requirement: 6.5.
Three letters of recommendation.
For international students: this form for financial responsibility (required by the US government)
Optional: For Ph.D. applications, this form to apply for an assistantship.
Application deadlines for admission to graduate programs:
International applicants: Fall - 15th April, Spring - 15th September
US applicants: Fall - 15th July, Spring - 1st December (US applicants applying after 15th April/15th September, please contact the Director of Graduate Studies before applying online.)
Teaching Assistantships
Teaching Assistantships provide a stipend and tuition waiver. Assistantships are offered only to PhD students. Most assistantships are awarded prior to the fall semester, although applications will also be considered for the spring semester. Application deadlines for assistantships:
Fall - 15th January, Spring - 15th September
Fellowships
Fellowships provide a stipend and tuition waiver. Fellowship awards are made in February. To be considered for these, students must submit completed applications, including official scores on the General Test of the Graduate Record Examinations. Application deadlines for fellowships:
1st January
